title: Workflow Improvement
description:
Studied the principles of facility planning and layout design, focusing on optimizing space utilization, material flow, and operational efficiency in manufacturing and service facilities.

Key Topics Covered:

Facility Planning: Understanding facility planning objectives, requirements, and systematic planning procedures.

Facility Layout Design: Evaluating different layout configurations, including product, process, fixed-position, and cellular layouts.

Systematic Layout Planning (SLP): Analyzing relationships between departments and activities to support effective facility arrangements.

Material Handling: Evaluating material movement, transportation distances, and handling requirements to improve operational flow.

Space Requirements: Estimating space needs for equipment, workstations, storage, and supporting activities.

Flow Analysis: Studying process flow, activity relationships, and movement patterns to identify layout improvement opportunities.

Layout Evaluation: Comparing alternative facility layouts based on space utilization, material flow, operational efficiency, and practical constraints.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how facility layout decisions influence productivity, material handling efficiency, space utilization, and overall operational performance.

Applied facility planning concepts in academic projects involving production layouts, space allocation, and material flow improvement.
